'''Horox Ryyder''' was an [[Anx]] [[Gender|male]] who served as a [[senator]] for the [[Raioballo sector]] in the [[Galactic Senate|Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic]]. Respected and loved by the entire Republic, he had a quiet and soothing demeanor and was well known for his patience and insight. In a career spanning over five [[Standard decade|decades]], Ryyder traveled [[the galaxy]] to visit constituents when not on the Republic [[capital]] of [[Coruscant]] and made many allies in the Senate. He supported the candidacy of Senator [[Finis Valorum]] for [[Supreme Chancellor]] and was pleased when Valorum began to tax trade routes.

Ryyder attended a session of the Senate in [[32 BBY]] in which [[Monarch of Naboo|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]] of [[Naboo]] called for a [[Vote of No Confidence]] in Valorum, which succeeded. Under the new chancellor, [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]], the Republic suffered a series of crises over the next ten [[Standard year|years]]. Exhausted and depressed, Ryyder eventually retired from his position several [[Standard week|weeks]] before the [[Clone Wars]] began in [[22 BBY]]. In retirement, he once again set out to travel to the worlds he had represented, but, as a great opera lover, continued to visit the [[Galaxies Opera House]] on Coruscant, where he was present in [[19 BBY]] during a performance of ''[[Squid Lake]]''.

==Biography==
===Veteran politician===
[[File:Ryyder-VE.png|thumb|right|200px|Horox Ryyder was senator of the Raioballo sector.]]
Horox Ryyder was an [[Anx]]<ref name="Geektionary" /> [[Gender|male]]<ref name="FC" /> from the [[planet]] [[Gravlex Med]]<ref name="Geektionary French" /> who served as a [[senator]] for his [[homeworld]]<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> and the thousands of other worlds in the [[Raioballo sector]]<ref name="Geektionary" /> in the [[Galactic Republic]]'s [[Galactic Senate]] in a career that lasted for over fifty [[Standard year|years]].<ref name="FC" /> During this [[time]], the skills and knowledge he accrued allowed him to make many allies in the Senate, including the [[Alderaanian]] Senator [[Bail Prestor Organa|Bail Organa]], the [[Wookiee]] Senator [[Yarua]],<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> and [[Tendau Bendon]].<ref name="EnglishEncyclopedia">{{EncyclopediaCite|Chancellors, Senators and States Persons of the Republic}} {{C|English version only}}</ref> An extremely conscientious [[Politics|politician]], Ryyder traveled across [[the galaxy]] when not on the Republic's [[capital]], [[Coruscant]], causing some to joke that the Anx wished to meet each of his constituents personally.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

Although corruption had been endemic in the Republic before Ryyder took office, he sometimed percieved causes for hope within the Senate's ambient greed. One of these was his colleague [[Finis Valorum]], whom the Anx saw as an honorable man capable of restoring the Republic's past honor. When Valorum ran for the office of [[Supreme Chancellor]], Ryyder supported his candidacy, and after Valorum succeeded, the Anx also supported his taxation of trade routes, having noticed that trade guilds such as the [[Trade Federation]] were one of the main causes of the failures in the Republic's political system. Convinced that the taxation would lessen the guilds' influence, Ryyder rejoiced when it was finally adopted; however, his enthusiasm was short-lived, as he soon learned that Valorum had been discredited by a serious scandal.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

===A hard ten years===
The next [[Standard decade|decade]] would be the worst of Ryyder's career, with all of his efforts proving insufficient to change the Senate's corruption.<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> In [[32 BBY]],<ref name="TPMDate">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas: Updated Edition]]'' dates the events of {{Film|I}} to [[32 BBY]].</ref> he attended a session of the Senate in the [[Imperial Senate Building|Senate Building]] on Coruscant. There, [[Monarch of Naboo|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]] of the planet [[Naboo]] made a plea for the Senate to help her end the [[Invasion of Naboo|invasion]] of her homeworld by the [[Trade Federation Droid Army|forces]] of the Trade Federation. Ryyder sat with another Anx in a [[repulsorpod]] that had been adjacent to Amidala's pod while the Trade Federation representative [[Lott Dod]] stalled Amidala's request with support from Senator [[Aks Moe]]. The [[queen]] then called for a [[Vote of No Confidence]] in Valorum, sending the Senate into an uproar.<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref>

[[File:RyyderPod-TPM.png|thumb|left|300px|Horox Ryyder (bottom right) witnessed Queen Padmé Amidala call for a Vote of No Confidence in Supreme Chancellor Finis Valorum.]]
Valorum was replaced as Supreme Chancellor by Senator [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]],<ref name="TPM" /> under whom the Republic saw a series of successive crises culminating in the formation of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Separatist Crisis]]. Ryyder agreed to support Amidala, by then a senator, in her opposition to the [[Military Creation Act]], but while doing so, the exhausted and depressed Anx realized he could no longer carry out his duties. Just a few [[Standard week|weeks]] before the outbreak of the [[Clone Wars]]<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> in [[22 BBY]],<ref name="Atlas">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas: Updated Edition]]''</ref> Ryyder left his post as one of the most respected representatives in the Senate.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

===Retirement===
Ryyder's retirement was a bitter one, as he knew that the Republic faced further difficult times ahead. The Anx's colleagues missed him once he was gone, but no one was surprised when the retired Ryyder chose to visit all the planets he had represented while in office. However, this grueling journey, while an extraordinary initiative, only further exhausted the old Anx due to the sorry state of galactic politics. Despite this, he continued to speak out against the greed and corruption in politics.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

[[File:RyyderOpera-ROTS.png|thumb|right|300px|A great lover of opera, Horox Ryyder (right) attended a showing of ''Squid Lake''.]]
A great lover of [[opera]], Ryyder was a regular at the [[Galaxies Opera House]] on Coruscant and continued to attend even in his retirement.<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> In [[19 BBY]],<ref name="ROTSDate">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas: Updated Edition]]'' dates the events of [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']], which includes Horox Ryyder's appearance, to [[19 BBY]].</ref> he was present in the building during a performance<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref> of the [[Mon Calamari]] ballet ''[[Squid Lake]]''.<ref name="Comprehensive Guide">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]''</ref> He sat on a bench in one of the Opera House's corridors conversing with two [[human]]s as the [[Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker]] rushed past on his way to Supreme Chancellor Palpatine's personal viewing box.<ref name="ROTS" />

==Personality and traits==
At over four [[meter]]s tall,<ref name="Geektionary" /> Horox Ryyder's imposing stature set him apart from other senators, but his presence went beyond merely his physical appearance. Although he had a relatively tough approach to current affairs,<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> Ryyder was well known for his patience and insight,<ref name="FC" /> which along with his integrity, charisma, and serious nature, earned him the respect and admiration of the entire Republic. Calm, wise, and extremely conscientious,<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> he possessed a quiet and soothing demeanor that made the senator gain many allies.<ref name="FC" /> Ryyder's five decades of experience saw him acquire a great deal of skill, knowledge, and facilities that few could equal. However, it also left him bitter, exhausted, and depressed, regretting old times and what had become of the Republic and Senate.<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> Ryyder had [[Color|orange]] [[eye]]s<ref name="VE" /> and yellow skin<ref name="Geektionary" /> and was a great lover of opera.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

==Equipment==
At Amidala's Vote of No Confidence, Ryyder [[Clothing|wore]] orange and purple [[robe]]s with golden detailing and a high collar to the Senate Building.<ref name="FC" /> While at the Opera House, he wore orange robes with golden detailing.<ref name="ROTS" />

==Behind the scenes==
===Character origins===
[[File:Anxconcept.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Doug Chiang created concept art used for Ryyder.]]
Horox Ryyder first appeared in the [[1999]] [[prequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']],<ref name="TPM" /> where he was portrayed by [[Jerome Blake]].<ref name="Interview">{{WebCite|url=https://www.scifinow.co.uk/interviews/star-wars-interview-john-coppinger/2|text=Star Wars interview: John Coppinger|author=Hoare, James|date=2011-09-01|work=[[Wikipedia:SciFiNow|SciFiNow]]|archivedate=20190727180605}}</ref> Although Ryyder is visible in one shot of the film in a senate pod to the lower right of the [[Naboo delegation]]'s pod and his pod remains visible, the character is not visible in the following shot that shows the Naboo delegation's pod detaching from the [[Galactic Senate Chamber]]'s wall.<ref name="TPM" /> Ryyder's scene in the [[2005]] prequel trilogy film, [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']], was shot entirely on blue-screen<ref name="SkywalkerSage">''[[Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga]]'' — [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Revenge of the Sith'']]: "ILM Episode III Siggraph Reel"</ref> on R Stage at [[Shepperton Studios]] as part of additional photography on Monday, [[August 23]], [[2004]].<ref name="MakingOf">''[[The Making of Star Wars Revenge of the Sith]]''</ref>

Ryyder's design originated in a piece of concept art drawn by artist [[Doug Chiang]] for which sculptor [[John Coppinger]] created the 3D character maquette. Coppinger liked the concept sketch enough that he only made small alterations necessary to translate the design from 2D to 3D when sculpting, adding some details and changing proportions. The maquette was ultimately used in the creation of both Ryyder and another Anx<ref name="Interview" /> named [[Graxol Kelvyyn]].<ref name="Kelvyyn">{{Topps|set=2016 Topps Star Wars: Rogue One Mission Briefing|cardname=John Coppinger as Graxol Kelvyyn|link=https://www.tcdb.com/ViewCard.cfm/sid/137403/cid/11208727/2016-Topps-Star-Wars-Rogue-One-Mission-Briefing---Autographs-NNO-John-Coppinger}}</ref>

===Costume design and name===
[[File:GraxolKelvyyn.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Horox Ryyder's rig was also used for Graxol Kelvyyn (Pictured).]]
The basic rig for both Anx characters consisted of the performer standing on twenty-four-inch stilts with the head standing thirty-six inches above that of the performer, making the character almost eleven feet tall in total. The rig was shown to director [[George Lucas]] with Coppinger inside, allowing Lucas to realize that including an Anx in frame with shorter characters such as [[Yoda]] would require the camera to be too far back. As such, Ryyder and Kelvyyn are only ever shown sitting down.<ref name="Interview" />

In the new ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], the character's name was first used in the [[Star Wars video games|mobile card game]] ''[[Star Wars: Force Collection]]'',<ref name="FC" /> which initially launched in [[2013]]. Although the launch of ''Force Collection'' predates<ref name="Force Collection release">{{SW|url=news/announcing-star-wars-force-collection|text=Announcing Star Wars: Force Collection|nolive=1}}</ref> the ''Star Wars'' canon reset of [[2014]],<ref name="Legends">{{SW|url=news/the-legendary-star-wars-expanded-universe-turns-a-new-page|text=The Legendary Star Wars Expanded Universe Turns a New Page}}</ref> [[Lucasfilm Story Group]] member [[Leland Chee]] confirmed that the game was kept updated to fit with canon.<ref name="Twitter">{{Twitter|HolocronKeeper|status/846807700482666496|[[Leland Chee]]|quote=I'm not gonna go through the trouble of changing them and I don't have any reason to believe currently that anyone would. […] On the off-chance that we DID have a current need to change any of these, we would have for Force Collection.|archivefile=File:Leland_Chee_Force_Collection.png|archivedate=20190727175219}} — [[Leland Chee]] of the [[Lucasfilm Story Group]] has confirmed that [[in-universe]] information from ''[[Star Wars: Force Collection]]'' conforms with the new ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]].</ref> The name originated in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, where it was first used in [[The Official Star Wars: Episode I Souvenir Magazine|''Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace The Official Souvenir Magazine'']], which was released alongside the film by [[Topps]].<ref name="Souvenir Magazine">''[[The Official Star Wars: Episode I Souvenir Magazine]]''</ref>
